tool_args.rationale: The monotone-concave signature and verified subtree guidance select the square-root completion of the two-layer siphon. Fit its three parameters numerically across the pilot rows, allowing the specified wide fallback range, and test on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows identify the three parameters of the guided square-root branch, so an additional branch probe is not yet warranted.
Pilot gradients remain below the specified 2.36 gray-zone threshold, and the high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
The observed sink-gradient dependence and matched subtree support the siphon mechanism instead.
